description: Bordure de chaussée is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données représente par des linéaires, les limites de la chaussée sur le territoire Bordeaux Métropole. Certaines ont fait l'objet d'un lever topographique et sont matérialisées soit par la présence de trottoirs soit par un changement de revêtement (indiqué dans l'attribut 'BORDURE' qui informe de la présence ou non de bordures). Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Infrastructure physique (réseau). Its keywords are bordures, cartographies, data-gouv. The portal shows 203,676 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
